fact: On 17 December 2025 the Digital Transition Ministry and Tamwilcom launched the Startup Venture Building offer under Digital Morocco 2030, with over 700 MDH to support more than 800 startups over three years and six operator contracts signed.
title: Rabat : Lancement officiel du déploiement de l'offre "Startup Venture Building" pour l'accompagnement et le financement des startups
